title: GTA 6 Hype Boosts PS5 and Xbox Console Sales by 30%
description: Even though GTA 6 is still a couple of months away from release, the incredible hype is already giving PS5 and Xbox console sales a 30% boost in the UK.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The GTA 6 Effect: Hardware Sales Surge Early

Even though Rockstar Games' inevitable pile of cash and the game itself are still a couple of months away from dropping, the sheer hype surrounding *GTA 6* is already having a massive impact on the market. According to recent reports from gaming outlet Eurogamer, the anticipation for the game has given PlayStation and Xbox console sales a much-needed 30% boost, at least in the UK.

## A Welcome Surge for the UK Hardware Market

For current-generation hardware markets, a sudden 30% increase in sales prior to a game's launch highlights the extraordinary pull of the franchise. Industry observers note that many gamers who have held off on upgrading their systems are now securing their PS5 or Xbox consoles well ahead of time, ensuring they are fully prepared when Rockstar Games finally releases the title.

## Unprecedented Pre-Release Momentum

Usually, hardware spikes align directly with a major title's release window. However, *GTA 6* is proving to be an exception, generating significant economic and market momentum months in advance. This early surge demonstrates just how deeply the upcoming open-world epic influences consumer behavior across the entire gaming ecosystem.

## Editor's Take

It is remarkable to see *GTA 6* driving a 30% console sales increase long before the game is even in players' hands. This early hardware boost underscores the unparalleled magnitude of the franchise and sets the stage for a historic launch when the game finally arrives.
